meta.title: Telemetry Triage — Endpoints & Vendor Dispositions
meta.note: Observed responses are ingestion-boundary facts. They establish receipt and parsing only — not retention, trusted use, or downstream impact (see whitepaper claim boundaries). Vendor dispositions are reproduced from correspondence.

families.name: Application Insights (Azure Monitor)
families.notes: Unauthenticated envelopes accepted under production instrumentation keys (iKeys). iKeys are documented as non-secret client configuration; the open question is downstream provenance of accepted events.
families.status: Closed by MSRC — assessed Low severity; case closed Aug 25, 2026. Source-map exposure fixed (removed at build time); tenant names in feature-flag comments removed. Telemetry-injection element assessed by MSRC as consistent with documented iKey design (not a secret, no auth boundary). RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-04: HTTP 200 itemsAccepted:1 — still accepting unauthenticated injection (single benign canary).
families.claim: Ingestion acceptance confirmed. Retention/trust classification not independently verifiable from outside. Re-verified post-closure 2026-09-04: ingestion acceptance confirmed again.

families.name: OneCollector / 1DS
families.notes: 1DS pipeline feeds Windows/Office/Teams/Xbox telemetry. Events accepted without producer authentication.
families.status: Reported to MSRC as separate case; security-assurance-engineer follow-up requested per correspondence. RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-04: HTTP 401 InvalidTenantToken on July payload shape — behavior changed; fixed-vs-format-drift undetermined (open question).
families.claim: Ingestion acceptance confirmed (204). Downstream handling per Microsoft = backend validation/filtering; not externally verifiable.

families.name: Gateway Admin Portal source maps (informational exposure, now fixed)
families.notes: Complete TypeScript source maps for Power BI Gateway Admin Portal across global, pre-prod, test, MSIT, TIP, US Gov High/Mil/CanaryHigh and China clouds. Internal IP ranges (10.240.0.0/16, 10.224.0.0/12) in US Gov High localization file.
families.status: FIXED by Microsoft — production builds no longer generate source maps; tenant names removed (Aug 25, 2026 confirmation).
families.claim: Exposure confirmed pre-fix; remediation confirmed by vendor.

families.name: Android Check-In
families.notes: Bootstrap check-in accepts unauthenticated device-identity-like fields (android_id, security_token, device_info) with no proof of producer control. Corrected VRP report scoped strictly to the provenance boundary and requests a canary trace.
families.status: Google position: unauthenticated bootstrap intentional; stats_ok = received/parsed. Server-side segregation asserted by Google; external verification of full trace not yet provided. Corrected report requests concrete canary disposition.
families.claim: Ingestion acceptance confirmed. Any Waymo/BigQuery/ML claim was withdrawn from the formal report as not externally verifiable.

families.name: Google Analytics 4
families.notes: Measurement Protocol accepts unauthenticated events for GA4 properties.

families.name: iCloud metrics + diagnostics
families.notes: Metrics/diagnostics endpoints accept unauthenticated JSON, text, and binary payloads.

families.name: Pixel / internal log & metrics / wearables DAT
families.notes: Pixel conversion + internal log/metrics endpoints accept unauthenticated events; wearables DAT accepts glasses telemetry event types.
families.status: Initially closed as intended behavior; follow-up report submitted on same number per researcher correspondence.

families.name: Ad conversion & analytics telemetry
families.notes: 39+ endpoints; x-li-uuid event IDs and x-li-fabric prod markers observed in responses.

families.name: Baidu Analytics / click tracking
families.notes: Tracking pixel family accepts unauthenticated events.

families.name: Tencent trace / analytics
families.notes: Trace endpoint accepts unauthenticated key/value events.

families.name: Matomo tracking (self-hosted class)
families.notes: Default config accepts unauthenticated tracking; class applies to self-hosted instances.

families.name: Segment-backed analytics
families.notes: Segment write key exposed in client-side JS bundles enables unauthenticated event submission into first-party analytics pipeline.
families.claim: Ingestion acceptance confirmed; write key exposure confirmed in client bundle.
